name: Steaming Fields (5-6)
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-24: Lightning Strikes, Stars Fall
description: A field of warm mist covers an open plain. Pockets of highly pressurized steam lie Hidden in the earth; pressure releases jets of steam.
disable: DC 26 Survival (expert) twice to navigate a safe path

generalAbilities.name: Steam Jet
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature fails a skill check to navigate through the steaming field

Effect Several jets of pressurized steam erupt, dealing (2d6+6) Bludgeoning Damage]{2d6+6 bludgeoning damage and 2d6+6 fire damage} to creatures within 30 feet of the ground (Basic DC 24 Reflex Saving Throw).
